provenance: The 157 cases of fold 0 of the routing index's held-out split (corpus/routing/index.json; Ibn Rajab and Ibn al-Laḥḥām furūʿ) typed into Usul.Typing situations, LLM-assisted by four agents working blind: they saw each farʿ's committed text under an opaque id (record ids name the qāʿida) and a field catalogue generated from the Lean export, never the qāʿida, encoder or label. Quotes are verbatim, at most 160 characters. The 17 fold-0 cases of the RajabA13–A16 shards (qawāʿid 119–130), added at the 2026-10-14 merge, were typed by one agent that had seen their annotations, so not blind; likewise q128.f000, recovered and annotated at PR-30. The 22 fold-0 cases of the RajabA17–A20 shards (qawāʿid 132–146), added at the round-5 merge, were typed blind again, by one agent that saw only each farʿ's text under an opaque id and the generated field catalogue. Not human-reviewed.
